panels.description: Latest state per selected firewall and interface. Blank logical-interface state is unavailable.

targets.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT interface_name, admin_status, operational_status, speed, duplex, logical, wan_classified, wan_role, wan_display_name, rx_errors_total, rx_discards_total, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM interface WHERE collector = 'paloalto' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT interface_name AS "Interface", admin_status AS "Admin", operational_status AS "Operational", speed AS "Speed", duplex AS "Duplex", logical AS "Logical", wan_display_name AS "WAN Name", wan_role AS "WAN Role", rx_errors_total AS "RX Errors", rx_discards_total AS "RX Discards", time AS "Observed" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY interface_name
targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT interface_name, admin_status, operational_status, speed, duplex, logical, wan_classified, wan_role, wan_display_name, rx_errors_total, rx_discards_total, time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time DESC) AS rn FROM interface WHERE collector = 'paloalto' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring} AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT interface_name AS "Interface", admin_status AS "Admin", operational_status AS "Operational", speed AS "Speed", duplex AS "Duplex", logical AS "Logical", wan_display_name AS "WAN Name", wan_role AS "WAN Role", rx_errors_total AS "RX Errors", rx_discards_total AS "RX Discards", time AS "Observed" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY interface_name

panels.title: Interface Status

panels.description: Rates derived from cumulative counters; negative deltas after reset are omitted.

targets.query: WITH samples AS (SELECT time, interface_name, rx_bytes_total, tx_bytes_total, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_time, LAG(rx_bytes_total) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_rx, LAG(tx_bytes_total) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_tx FROM interface WHERE collector = 'paloalto' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring} AND wan_classified = true AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT time, interface_name, CASE WHEN rx_bytes_total >= previous_rx AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (rx_bytes_total - previous_rx) * 8 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) END AS rx_bps, CASE WHEN tx_bytes_total >= previous_tx AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (tx_bytes_total - previous_tx) * 8 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) END AS tx_bps FROM samples WHERE previous_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: WITH samples AS (SELECT time, interface_name, rx_bytes_total, tx_bytes_total, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_time, LAG(rx_bytes_total) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_rx, LAG(tx_bytes_total) OVER (PARTITION BY hostname, interface_name ORDER BY time) AS previous_tx FROM interface WHERE collector = 'paloalto' AND customer LIKE ${customer:sqlstring} AND site LIKE ${site:sqlstring} AND hostname LIKE ${device:sqlstring} AND wan_classified = true AND time >= $__timeFrom AND time <= $__timeTo) SELECT time, interface_name, CASE WHEN rx_bytes_total >= previous_rx AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (rx_bytes_total - previous_rx) * 8 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) END AS rx_bps, CASE WHEN tx_bytes_total >= previous_tx AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) > 0 THEN (tx_bytes_total - previous_tx) * 8 / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - previous_time)) END AS tx_bps FROM samples WHERE previous_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time
